content_sections.heading: About IICA
content_sections.text: The notice describes IICA, Manesar as an autonomous institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. It is meant to advance Corporate Affairs as an interdisciplinary discipline, to act as a government think tank on corporate laws, policies and governance, and to provide research, consultancy and information services. It also provides capacity building training to Group 'A' Government Officers and to public and private sector board members and executives through its five Schools and eleven Centres. Its address is Plot No.6, 7 & 8, Sector-5, IMT Manesar, District-Gurugram, PIN-121 052 (Haryana). Tele: 0124-264 0000; Fax: 0124-2291036.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice is dated 24 November 2026 and covers one position. The post is open to Indian citizens. The notice mentions no reservation for the post. Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Economics, Business Administration (BBA/MBA), or Public Policy and Governance from a recognised university or institution. Graduates: minimum 2 years of relevant post-qualification experience in research, data analysis or policy work. Post Graduates: minimum 1 year of relevant post-qualification experience. Fresh post graduates with strong academic records and research projects may also be considered. Coursework in statistics, econometrics or data analytics. Certification in data analytics, statistical software including use of AI tools and/or data visualisation. Experience in industry associations, professional bodies or consulting firms, involving engagement with policy or research on corporate affairs and financial stability. Not more than 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. Relaxation may be given to exceptionally qualified candidates at the discretion of the competent authority. Age, educational qualifications and experience are all counted as on the last date for submission of applications, 15 December 2026. Research competencies: framing research questions, literature review, research design, mixed methods (quantitative and qualitative), referencing and research ethics. Use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot for literature search, summarisation, drafting, coding support and data analysis, with judgement to verify outputs and protect confidential data. Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced functions, pivot tables) and at least one statistical tool (Stata, R, Python, SPSS or EViews). Working knowledge of data visualisation tools, and familiarity with Indian economic, corporate insolvency and public policy datasets. Strong analytical, report-writing and presentation skills in English; working knowledge of Hindi is desirable. Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and coordinate with multiple teams. Annexure-I of the official notification also lists desired skills such as understanding of the banking and financial services industry and strong communication and coordination skills. Discipline-specific eligibility is as set out in Annexure-I of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate is paid a monthly consolidated pay of Rs. 40,000/- per month for graduates and Rs. 50,000/- per month for post graduates, as printed in Annexure-I. The recruitment is contractual and extendable based on performance and project requirements. The notice states that no other allowances or benefits, such as Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Concession (LTC), medical facilities and other compensation packages, are admissible. Leave is granted as per the policy of the Institute. The notice does not state the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications received up to the due date/time are screened against the minimum educational qualifications and experience prescribed. Only shortlisted candidates are called for a presentation and/or interview before the duly constituted Selection Committee. The interview is held at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference, on a date and time to be communicated separately. IICA communicates only with shortlisted candidates. The Institute reserves the right to devise its criteria for shortlisting. Meeting the minimum qualification does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for the presentation and/or interview. IICA's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, equivalence of qualifications and the mode of screening/selection is final and binding. The notice does not give an interview date.
